trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied query expression (or string where) may carry server-side-JavaScript operators ($where/$function/$accumulator) or non-allowlisted top-level operators into the selector; decided (after the fix) in Mergeable#_mongoid_expand_keys and Mergeable#__override__ via Selectable#_mongoid_validate_operators!, and in Selectable#where for strings. At the pinned commit nothing decides it.

landing_point.why: Selectable#where is the documented entry for query expressions and the string form that compiles to $where; expr_query at :828 is where a hash with '$where' becomes an operator expression.

fix_sites.entry_point: where(Hash), find_by, find_or_create_by, find_or_initialize_by, and/all_of, or, nor, not, any_of (all call _mongoid_expand_keys)
fix_sites.module_kind: query builder internal normaliser (shared choke point)

fix_sites.entry_point: elem_match/eq/gt/gte/lt/lte/ne/mod/near/near_sphere/exists/with_size/with_type when overwrite_chained_operators is true, and not() on scalar values (selectable.rb:573)
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level merge strategy (@api private) reached from public chain methods

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/mongoid/criteria/queryable/mergeable.rb:342-355 (__override__, @api private strategy method writing straight to the selector, reached from elem_match/exists/etc. at selectable.rb:157,180 and not() at selectable.rb:573)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: __override__ is an @api private merge strategy used by typed operator helpers (elem_match, exists, gt...) whose operator is fixed by the method, so a solver can argue no caller-chosen top-level operator ever reaches it; geo_spatial/__merge__ is 'just a geo helper', and Storable is documented as taking pre-expanded expressions.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Criteria#for_js (BSON::Code via js_query, documented as injection-safe) must keep working, as must allowlisted top-level operators ($and/$or/$nor/$expr/$text/$comment/$jsonSchema) and ordinary $-operators nested under fields; a fix placed in js_query/add_operator_expression or rejecting all $-keys breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: top-level '$where' key as String or Symbol
JS operator nested inside $or/$and/$nor arrays (array depth)
operator smuggled through chained __override__ methods (elem_match etc.)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: geo_spatial(hash) -> __merge__ -> String#__expr_part__ stores a caller-chosen top-level key (e.g. '$where' or '$expr') straight into the selector with no operator guard; geo_spatial is also in Hash#to_criteria's allowlist, so Criteria#merge(hash) reaches it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Geo-only helper whose keys are normally Key objects like :location.within_polygon; 'not a general query expression method'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; sink in lib/mongoid/criteria/queryable/mergeable.rb:122-126 and extensions/string.rb:82-87

O8_uncovered_routes.route: in/nin/all under a union/intersect/override strategy go through with_strategy, which stores selector[field] directly, bypassing both _mongoid_expand_keys and Storable's '$'-field rejection, so a '$expr' key with an aggregation $in over $function is unguarded.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Requires the developer to call the strategy modifiers (union/intersect/override, mergeable.rb:20-40) first; obscure combination.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Criteria#merge!/merge copies another criteria's selector with Selector#merge!, which does no operator check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Any selector arriving there was already built by guarded methods, except the geo_spatial/strategy routes above.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: text_search merges caller opts into the $text clause with no walk; a variant that merges opts at the selector top level would be a realistic unguarded route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already writes query.selector directly, bypassing expand_keys, for option plumbing.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second, independent $where detector (valid_for_count_documents?) that only checks key == '$where' through hashes, not arrays or $function; a planted reuse of it as the guard would be a realistic how-type miss.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer could reuse an existing $where scanner instead of writing a new walker.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: any_of's multi-criterion branch builds raw hashes without expand_keys and relies on the later and('$or'=>...) for normalisation; a version that stores exprs directly would skip the guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The branch already differs from the single-criterion branch for historical reasons.

O9_family: NoSQL injection (CWE-943), server-side JavaScript operator injection via query builder

services: mongod (server-side behaviour; $where/$function require a real server with JS enabled)
O10_build.project_tests: spec/mongoid/criteria/queryable/selectable_where_spec.rb, selectable_logical_spec.rb, spec/mongoid/criteria_spec.rb; fix adds spec/integration/query_operator_guard_spec.rb. Guard raises before any server call, so most guard tests are selector-level and need no mongod.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject a top-level '$where' key (and the string form) in Selectable#where/expr_query only, missing $function inside $expr, $or arrays, the __override__ chain and geo_spatial.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commits are whole release candidates (8.0.13/8.1.13/9.0.12) bundling other advisories: in-memory regexp budget (matcher/regexp_budget.rb), nested-attributes reparenting/convert_id (association/nested/*), FieldReadable send-dispatch (contextual/memory.rb); the candidate's c_* counts (27 sites, read_field_value) reflect the bundle, not this advisory.
The 9.0.12 commit adds no __override__ guard in mergeable.rb (fix.diff:7467-7480), unlike 8.0.13 (fix.diff:534-545).
